Fuse globally consistent provisional identities from three or more cameras

aqt_multiview_global_fuse.Rd

Fuse verified one-to-one pairwise geometric fish hypotheses into one provisional reference-anchored 3D trajectory per fish.

Usage

aqt_multiview_global_fuse(pairwise_results, min_views = 2L,
  max_disagreement = 0.5)

Arguments

pairwise_results

Named automatic refractive pipeline outputs from a shared reference camera to distinct secondary cameras.

min_views

Minimum contributing total camera views (at least two).

max_disagreement

Maximum accepted disagreement of source-pairwise 3D XYZ estimates, in declared world physical units.

Value

An aqt_multiview_global_fusion object containing globally consistent provisional reference-fish identities, native aqt_tracks 3D positions or NULL, per-source observation counts, camera view support and rejected incompatible candidates.

Details

The matched tracks remain provisional geometric hypotheses: this function never independently certifies biological identity, actual camera exposure time, physical surveyed XYZ or fish welfare.
